data.title: Haven
data.about:
Unveiling Haven by Aldar Properties, Dubai's newest gem in residential luxury. This development stands as Aldar's inaugural masterpiece in the heart of Dubai, ringing in an era of unparalleled community wellness.

Imagine your mornings starting beneath the enchanting shade of a treehouse, with every moment at Haven meticulously crafted to elevate your wellbeing. As you venture further, the lullaby of a gently flowing stream becomes the backdrop of your days, offering a perpetual, calming presence.

Located in the vibrant realm of Dubailand, Haven isn't just a home; it's a statement. It promises a diverse range of contemporary homes, from premium 3 & 4 bedroom townhouses to opulent 3 to 6-bedroom villas, each echoing a harmonious blend of chic design and nature. A monumental canvas of 2,428 unique residences awaits, ranging from the elite allure of Haven Villas to the serene embrace of Park Haven Townhouses. Every unit stands as a testament to architectural excellence nestled in an oasis of lush, green tranquility.

location_tile.title: Perfectly Located in Dubailand
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Haven's positioning in Dubailand beautifully balances peace with accessibility. Nestled near E611 Emirates Road and D54 Zayed Bin Hamdan al Nahyan Street, residents have a swift route to Dubai's main thoroughfares. Such a prime spot guarantees that the buzz of city life and the calm of nature are always within reach.

  • 12 Minutes from Miracle Garden
  • 22 Minutes from Palm Jumeirah
  • 25 Minutes from Mall of Emirates
  • 25 Minutes from Dubai Marina
  • 25 Minutes from Downtown Dubai / Dubai Mall
